content:
maya: heads-up — ran the cb throughput sweep on staging just now, saw a weird spike in latency around the 15m mark
ken: spike as in median jump or tail latency? any numbers?
maya: median rose from ~180ms -> ~350ms, p99 from ~720ms -> ~1.8s. throughput dropped ~12% for ~3 minutes.
oliver: did you change max_batch_tokens or max_queue_len for that run?
maya: config used: max_batch_tokens=2048, max_batch_size=64, max_queue_len=128. No other changes.
sara: any OOMs or node reboots in the logs? link to perf dashboard: https://internal.redwood/perf/runs/1851239999
maya: no OOMs, but I see repeated KV cache misses around the window in the executor logs.
jamal: can you paste the profiler snippet + run id? also which model variant was used?
maya: model=redwood-open-7b-quant, run id=cb-sweep-2026-05-14
maya: ```
[2026-05-14T15:12:08Z] batch_executor: start batch size=52 tokens=1200
[2026-05-14T15:12:08Z] kv_cache: miss (seq=134)
[2026-05-14T15:12:08Z] kernel_selector: switched kernel=attn_v2 -> attn_v1 (seq_len=1024)
[2026-05-14T15:12:09Z] batch_executor: finish latency=0.34s
```
ken: kernel switch looks suspect — sounds like the kernel heuristic tripped on a seq_len spike. Did batching window config change?
oliver: also check if the few long inputs forced larger sequence-length buckets.
maya: loadgen trace shows a handful of outliers ~3k tokens around 15:12:07, likely a corrupted prompt or bad sample.
sara: quick mitigation: clamp max_input_len at the batching gateway for the sweep and enable strict kernel_policy (force attn_v2) to test stability.
jamal: I can run a filtered replay: drop inputs >1500 tokens and force_attn=attn_v2. Want me to run it now?
maya: yes please. Also open a small canary with reduced max_batch_size=48 and max_queue_len=80 to see sensitivity.
ken: also pinging infra — @oliver can you check GPU metrics (PCIe stalls, mem usage) around 15:12 for the hosts used?
oliver: on it, pulling telemetry.
ci-bot: build 1124 completed for cb-agent (staging) — unit tests passed :white_check_mark:
oliver: quick update: overall GPU util stayed ~92%, but host-7 showed brief PCIe wait spikes ~300ms that line up with the kernel switch times.
sara: that suggests a few long sequences both triggered kernel fallback and caused extra PCIe transfers. plan: jamal do the filtered replay + forced kernel; maya spin the canary with smaller batch; ken open infra ticket if stalls repeat. reconvene after results. :thumbsup:
jamal: scheduling replay now, ETA ~25m. I'll upload logs to /mnt/perf/artifacts/1851239999 and post link.
maya: thanks — once replay finishes I'll kick the canary and compare p50/p95/p99.
ken: filed infra ticket INF-3456 for the PCIe stall trace and attached host logs.
maya: noted, thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the consolidated numbers when both runs complete.
